target_customer: European STEM students who pay tuition as a share of future salary
problem: European university STEM courses are often outdated and theoretical, and students cannot afford private bootcamps upfront.
business_model: Income share agreement coding school, tuition deferred until employment
product_category: Online coding bootcamp with income share financing

founders.name: Tobia De Angelis
founders.background_notes: YC bio says Strive School is now part of Epicode where he is Chairman.

founders.name: Diego Banovaz
education: Master in computer engineering (institution not named, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC bio mentions consultancy, education and startups without naming employers.

technical_complexity.rationale: A curriculum and online delivery business; the hard parts were financing structure and placement, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Bootcamps with deferred tuition were easy to replicate and the sources show no proprietary data or exclusive partnerships.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Strive combined with Italian school Epicode in 2022 instead of being copied or bought by an incumbent.

market_need_then: Strive's pitch cites outdated European STEM teaching; no dated spend data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used strive.school, a new TLD domain.

rebrands.why: Merger of Strive with Epicode under the Epicode name, per tech.eu

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word; the brand was dropped for Epicode within about two years and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Strive School was a five person Berlin team selling income share coding training to European students. In March 2022 it joined Epicode, which rebranded around the combined company and raised 10 million euros from Italian angels and family offices, and Strive's co-founder became Chairman. Sources disagree on whether it was a March 2022 merger or a July 2023 acquisition, and the price is unknown, so it is an unclear exit.
notes: The 10 million euro round of March 2022 was raised by Epicode at the merger, not by Strive alone, so stage is other and no USD amount is recorded. CB Insights lists a 130 thousand dollar seed in August 2020 from Y Combinator, an aggregator figure that is unverified. A profile gives July 2023 for the acquisition, conflicting with March 2022. strive.school returned HTTP 403 and was not read. No dated competitor sources were found, so the list is empty.
